name: Day/Night Cycle
description: Time-of-day simulation driving lighting, spawn tables, and ambient events. One clock, an hour from 0 to 24 turning once every dayLengthMinutes; night from 18:00 to 06:00, its two edges announced as world.duskStarted and world.dawnStarted. It owns the hour and nothing it lights: a runtime reads `currentTime` and draws its own sky, sun and shadow from it, and a saved run hands the hour back as startTime.

implementations.note: Implemented in the consuming application; not verifiable from this repository.
Implemented in the consuming application; not verifiable from this repository.

inputs.name: dayLengthMinutes
inputs.description: Real minutes for one turn of the clock.

inputs.name: startTime
inputs.description: The hour the clock starts at, 0 to 24. A saved run hands back the hour it was saved at.

outputs.name: currentTime
outputs.description: The hour, 0 to 24, fractional. What a runtime lights from, and what a saved run hands back as startTime.
